sentences.ar: ג'וחא והבן שלו הלכו לשוק עם החמור.
sentences.en: Juha and his son went to the market with the donkey.
Juha rode and the boy walked.

sentences.ar: אנשים בדרך אמרו: תראו, האבא רוכב.
sentences.en: People on the road said: look, the father is riding.
And his son walks and is tired.
Juha got down and sat the boy on.

sentences.ar: אנשים אחרים אמרו: תראו, הילד רוכב.
sentences.en: Other people said: look, the boy is riding.
And his father is old and walking.
So the two of them rode together.

sentences.ar: ואנשים אחרים אמרו: מסכן, החמור עייף.
sentences.en: And other people said: poor thing, the donkey is tired.
In the end they both got down and walked.

sentences.ar: ג'וחא אמר לבן: מה שלא תעשה, ידברו.
sentences.en: Juha said to his son: whatever you do, people will talk.
